project.designRead: AI forum / general-interest Chinese users / modern minimal / information-dense task-driven / avoid generic 3-card hero and neon gradients

lowValueCallWatchdog.noProgressNextAction: halt and report summary of current progress and blockers

visualQualityCheckpoints.expected: A clean top navigation plus a focused content feed as the dominant first-screen structure; no decorative hero image needed for an information-dense forum.
Primary navigation, secondary filters/tags, and tertiary meta actions are separated by spacing, weight, and surface; AI features are visually distinct but not louder than content.
Centered max-width container with clear column rhythm; cards use subtle border or surface layering; generous whitespace consistent with modern minimalism.
CSS variable driven theme, Lucide icons, Tailwind semantic utilities, static critical-layout CSS for shell; no external image assets required for wireframe-like prototype.

sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: static surfaces use border or subtle surface layering; only modals/dropdowns use shadow-2/3

continuityAnchors: top navigation with logo, search, create button, and user avatar
neutral gray palette with single near-black primary
8pt spacing grid and restrained 4/8/12/16px radius scale
Lucide icon system at 20px for UI actions

pages.title: 首页
pages.visualNorthStar: Content-discovery hub: clean feed, subtle topic pills, visible AI-assisted recommendations, and a clear conversion path to create/ask/search.
requirements: 顶部导航栏（Logo、搜索、提问、发帖、通知、头像）
推荐内容流（帖子卡片列表）

pages.title: 版块列表页
pages.visualNorthStar: Board directory: scannable board grid, topic/tag filters, and a sorted post list that respects the selected board.
requirements: 帖子列表（标题、摘要、作者、数据）
排序控件（最新/热门/优质）

pages.title: 帖子详情页
pages.visualNorthStar: Reading and discussion surface: prominent post body, nested comments, AI discussion summary panel, and related recommendations without visual noise.
requirements: 帖子正文区（标题、作者、时间、标签、内容）
互动工具栏（点赞/收藏/分享/举报）

pages.title: 发帖编辑页
pages.visualNorthStar: Focused creation workspace: large editor, AI assistant sidebar, tag/board selectors, and a sticky publish bar that keeps the user in flow.
requirements: 内容编辑器（标题、正文输入）
AI 发帖助手面板（标题建议、标签建议、版块建议、敏感提醒）

pages.title: AI 答疑页
pages.visualNorthStar: Question-to-answer interface: clear input, streaming-answer-like AI response card with source citations, and a community supplement area.
requirements: AI 回答区（含来源引用卡片）

pages.title: 搜索结果页
pages.visualNorthStar: Search results surface: persistent search bar, category tabs, AI aggregate summary at top, and grouped result cards.
requirements: 分类筛选（帖子/用户/知识库）

pages.title: 个人主页
pages.visualNorthStar: Identity and content portfolio: profile card with influence metrics, tabbed content lists, and follow/follower counts.
requirements: 用户资料卡（头像、昵称、简介、数据）
内容列表标签（发帖/收藏/关注）

wiringPlan.description: 共享顶部导航壳：Logo 返回首页，搜索进入搜索页，提问进入 AI 答疑，发布进入编辑器，头像/个人入口进入个人主页。
内容卡片/标题点击进入帖子详情页。
作者/用户头像或昵称点击进入个人主页。
首页侧边栏话题标签进入搜索页，版块快捷入口进入版块列表页。
编辑器发布按钮提交后进入帖子详情页。

hiddenInteractionPlan.description: 未登录用户首页浏览 5 分钟后触发认证入口弹层，引导登录/注册。
未登录用户点击发布按钮时重定向到登录/注册页。
